en.headline: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory musical opens at Cultural Centre this week
en.dek: The Broadway production of the Roald Dahl story runs from 4 November to 6 December at the Grand Theatre, performed in English with Chinese surtitles.
body: The musical adaptation of Roald Dahl’s Charlie and the Chocolate Factory opens at the Grand Theatre of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre on 4 November and runs until 6 December.

Produced by Broadway International Group and presented in association with Broadway Asia and other partners, the show is performed in English with Traditional Chinese surtitles. It lasts about 145 minutes including a 20-minute intermission. There are no performances on Mondays.

Daniel Plimpton plays Willy Wonka, with young actors Oliver Wong and Leo Caravano alternating as Charlie Bucket. Ticket prices range from HK$388 to HK$1,288 depending on the day and seating. Eight additional performances were added in early December following demand.
The organisers said the production features the stagecraft of illusion specialist Tim Clothier. Details of showtimes and booking are available through the official production channels.

zh.headline: 《朱古力獎門人》音樂劇本周於文化中心開演
zh.dek: 百老匯版羅爾德·達爾故事改編音樂劇由11月4日至12月6日在香港文化中心大劇院上演，英語演出配繁體中文字幕。
body: 改編自羅爾德·達爾《朱古力獎門人》的百老匯音樂劇將於11月4日在香港文化中心大劇院開演，演出至12月6日。
演出由Broadway International Group製作，與Broadway Asia等合作呈獻，以英語進行並附繁體中文字幕。全長約145分鐘，包括20分鐘中場休息。星期一休演。
Daniel Plimpton飾演威利·旺卡，小演員Oliver Wong與Leo Caravano輪流飾演查理。票價由388至1288港元不等，視乎日子及座位而定。因反應熱烈，主辦方已加開12月初共八場演出。
主辦方表示，舞台融入了幻術專家Tim Clothier的設計。詳細場次及購票安排可經官方渠道查詢。
